components.name: Primary action
components.description: Enabled manual retry; the same visual treatment is used by the unknown-route home link. Static preview, not an API control.
components.css: .ds-action-frame { background: #101b26; padding: 24px; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-button { background: var(--action, #e9d7b6); color: #17232e; border: 1px solid var(--action, #e9d7b6); border-radius: 5px; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 18px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e9d7b6); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.98); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #f4e6cc; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: none; } }

components.name: Checking action
components.description: Native disabled retry during the one in-flight check; uses explicit disabled colors, not faded opacity.
components.css: .ds-check-frame { background: #101b26; padding: 24px; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-check-button { background: var(--action, #e9d7b6); color: #17232e; border: 1px solid var(--action, #e9d7b6); border-radius: 5px; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 18px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-check-button:disabled { background: #2b3d4b; color: #c0ced8; border-color: #526878; cursor: wait; } .ds-check-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e9d7b6); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-check-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.98); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-check-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #f4e6cc; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-check-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: none; } }

components.name: Documentation link
components.description: Underlined API documentation action. Preview uses a local fragment instead of inventing a service URL.
components.html: API documentation (opens in a new tab)
components.css: .ds-link-frame { background: #101b26; color: #e7eff5; padding: 24px; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-text-link { color: inherit; text-underline-offset: .3em; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e9d7b6); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-link-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-text-link:hover { color: var(--action, #e9d7b6); } }

components.name: Foundation navigation
components.description: Temporary title plus one service-status route; mobile keeps the same header. Current-route preview.
components.html:
Game Discovery.
Service status
components.css: .ds-header { background: #101b26; color: #e7eff5; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; min-height: 100px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #334756); } .ds-wordmark { color: inherit; font-weight: 750; font-size: 20px; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-wordmark span { color: var(--action, #e9d7b6); } .ds-nav { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted, #adbecb); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; padding-block: 12px; text-underline-offset: .3em; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color: #e7eff5; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-header a { touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-header a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e9d7b6); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--action, #e9d7b6); } } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-header { min-height: 84px; } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 17px; } .ds-nav { font-size: 12px; } }

components.name: Connection copy
components.description: Static snapshot of the implemented initial loading state; colored states remain paired with written labels. No simulated API result.
components.html:
Checking the connection…

Connecting to the API

The free demo may need up to a minute to wake up. This check runs once; it won’t poll in the background.
components.css: .ds-connection { background: #101b26; color: #e7eff5; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; border-block: 1px solid var(--line, #334756); padding: 36px 0 40px; } .ds-connection h2 { font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.025em; margin: 0 0 12px; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-connection p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted, #adbecb); margin: 0; line-height: 1.8; max-width: 65ch; } .ds-connection .ds-connection-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-state-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--muted, #adbecb); border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-state-dot.ds-connected { background: #93ccb4; border-color: #93ccb4; } .ds-state-dot.ds-failed { background: #e9b69d; border-color: #e9b69d; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-connection { padding-top: 28px; } }

components.name: Catalog facts
components.description: Three-row definition list, using the actual initial unknown state rather than fabricated catalog metrics.
components.css: .ds-facts { background: #101b26; color: #e7eff5; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; margin: 0; padding-top: 4px; font-size: 13px; min-width: 0; } .ds-facts div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #334756); } .ds-facts div:first-child { padding-top: 0; } .ds-facts dt { color: var(--muted, #adbecb); } .ds-facts dd { margin: 0; text-align: right; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-facts { max-width: 480px; } }

components.name: Keyboard skip link
components.description: Hidden-at-rest link revealed on keyboard focus. The bounded dark preview frame supplies a local main target.
components.html: Skip to content
components.css: .ds-skip-frame { position: relative; background: #101b26; color: #e7eff5; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; min-height: 100px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-skip-link { position: absolute; left: 24px; top: 16px; background: var(--action, #e9d7b6); color: #101b26; padding: 12px; transform: translateY(-160%); z-index: 1; text-underline-offset: .3em; touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-skip-link:focus-visible, .ds-skip-main:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e9d7b6); outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview:
This is the documented foundation system for the temporary M1 service-status surface, not a final release design. “Game Discovery” is the approved temporary title. No named creative metaphor or final brand identity has been approved. The confirmed direction is restrained, dark and minimal: compact sans typography, pale text, a quiet warm action color and flat sections separated by hairlines.

The implemented page makes a real connection state readable, distinguishes an unpublished catalog from a service failure, and provides manual retry and API documentation. Its generous spacing supports a small amount of operational information. These patterns describe the current foundation; they do not decide the identity or composition of later game-discovery surfaces.

Evidence: `PRODUCT.md`, `docs/design/foundation.md`, `frontend/src/styles.css` and `frontend/src/App.tsx`. Frontmatter is the normative extracted token layer; the source remains authoritative for application behavior. The schema-v2 sidecar holds component previews, focus, motion and breakpoint details. Its synthesized tonal ramps are panel-only previews, not additional approved application colors.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained dark ground with pale readable text and warm action emphasis.
Flat sections and hairline separators rather than elevated cards.
Compact operational typography with a larger left-aligned introduction.
Explicit connection states, manual retry and accessible focus feedback.
Temporary M1 foundation, with final branding and discovery surfaces unresolved.

rules.name: The State Is Written Rule
rules.body: Keep loading, connected and failed states explicit in text; color alone never communicates the service state.

rules.name: The Flat Foundation Rule
rules.body: For this M1 surface, separate regions with spacing and hairlines rather than elevated containers.

rules.name: The One Check Rule
rules.body: Check on entry, then let the visitor retry manually; do not poll or animate a continuing activity after the request completes.

dos: Do preserve the restrained dark, flat foundation and its hairline separators.
Do pair each status color with explicit loading, connected or failed text.
Do keep manual retry, readable disabled controls, visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion press feedback.
Do stack the status columns at the existing mobile breakpoint and allow long values to wrap.
Do distinguish unpublished, unknown and unavailable catalog data using real service evidence.
Do treat this document as the temporary M1 foundation, with later visual decisions requiring their own approved scope.
donts: Don't present “Game Discovery” or this foundation as a final approved brand identity.
Don't add game cards, images, synthetic catalog metrics or M2 discovery controls to this M1 surface.
Don't treat a reachable but unpublished catalog as a failed connection.
Don't introduce automatic polling or animated loading ceremonies into the manual-check pattern.
Don't promote the sidecar's synthesized tonal ramps into application tokens or owner-approved palette decisions.
